answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Queues. Each new identity must complete a slow ember trial: low-value jobs that pay nothing until its accuracy score crosses a threshold. An honest agent absorbs that delay once; a sybil farm absorbs it per clone, multiplying forgery cost linearly. Task routers forge assignments from each score, so fresh clones stay quarantined, and a prism audit flags identical answer patterns across accounts, freezing the whole cluster's payout.
